summary_cn: 泰国气象部门发布第7号天气警告。南部地区降雨增强，部分地区可能出现暴雨，建议居民和游客警惕持续降雨积累可能引发的洪涝灾害。同时北部地区气温下降，伴随较强风力，民众出行和工作需提前做好防护准备。

title: Generali devises plan to achieve top 3 status in Thailand
desc: The Thai unit of Italian insurer Generali is targeting a top three ranking for health and unit-linked insurance within three years by focusing on product development, wider distribution and better customer experience.

summary_cn: 意大利保险集团泛欧泛亚（Generali）泰国分公司制定三年发展计划，力争在健康保险和投资连结保险市场排名进入前三。公司将通过强化产品开发、扩大销售渠道及优化客户体验等多项措施实现目标。
desc_original: The Thai unit of Italian insurer Generali is targeting a top three ranking for health and unit-linked insurance within three years by focusing on product development, wider distribution and better customer experience.

title: Executives wary of tariff effect on exports
desc: The US's proposed 18% tariff on Thai exports, although broadly in line with rates imposed on other competing Asian economies and less than Vietnam's 20% rate, could weigh on Thailand's export performance in 2027, with growth expected to slow significantly from this year, warn business leaders and economists.
title_cn: 美国关税政策冲击泰国出口 商界领袖敲警钟
summary_cn: 美国拟对泰国商品征收18%关税。虽然税率与其他亚洲竞争国相当、低于越南的20%，但商界领导人和经济学家普遍担忧，该措施可能显著拖累泰国2027年出口增速。
desc_original: The US's proposed 18% tariff on Thai exports, although broadly in line with rates imposed on other competing Asian economies and less than Vietnam's 20% rate, could weigh on Thailand's export performance in 2027, with growth expected to slow significantly from this year, warn business leaders and economists.

title: Thailand shifts focus to investment-led growth
desc: Amid trade wars and economic fragmentation, with tariffs being used as tools to restrict commerce, Thailand has vowed to step up negotiations to secure the most favourable tariff rates possible to safeguard the competitiveness of its private sector.
title_cn: 泰国转向投资驱动增长 力争最优关税待遇保护竞争力
summary_cn: 在全球贸易战和经济分化加剧背景下，泰国宣布转向投资驱动增长战略，同时承诺加强谈判以获得最具竞争力的关税待遇，保护本国私营部门国际竞争力。
desc_original: Amid trade wars and economic fragmentation, with tariffs being used as tools to restrict commerce, Thailand has vowed to step up negotiations to secure the most favourable tariff rates possible to safeguard the competitiveness of its private sector.

title: Calls grow for stronger laws to tackle AI cyberthreats
desc: Thailand's existing legal framework is ill-equipped to deal with the growing threat of artificial intelligence (AI)-powered cyber-attacks, with three laws failing to address the scale and complexity of emerging threats, warns a technology law specialist.
title_cn: 泰国法律框架滞后 专家呼吁加强AI网络威胁防护法规
summary_cn: 技术法律专家警告，泰国现行法律框架难以应对人工智能驱动的网络攻击日益增长的威胁。现有三部法律无法充分应对新兴网络威胁的规模和复杂性，亟需完善相关法律。
desc_original: Thailand's existing legal framework is ill-equipped to deal with the growing threat of artificial intelligence (AI)-powered cyber-attacks, with three laws failing to address the scale and complexity of emerging threats, warns a technology law specialist.

title: PM vows to keep armed forces ready
desc: Prime Minister Anutin Charnvirakul has pledged to fund national defence and military preparedness to ensure the armed forces are ready to protect the country's sovereignty.
title_cn: 总理承诺确保武装力量战备就绪
summary_cn: 总理阿努廷·查尼瓦拉昆 Anutin Charnvirakul 承诺增加国防资金投入，加强军事备战工作，确保泰国武装力量时刻准备好维护国家主权和领土完整。在地区安全形势复杂多变的背景下，增强军队的作战能力和应急响应能力对泰国的国防安全至关重要。
desc_original: Prime Minister Anutin Charnvirakul has pledged to fund national defence and military preparedness to ensure the armed forces are ready to protect the country's sovereignty.

title: Three honoured for health contributions
desc: A Thai cardiologist, a Belgian foetal surgery pioneer and a Mexican nutrition researcher have been named recipients of the 2026 Prince Mahidol Awards for their outstanding contributions to global health.
title_cn: 三位医学专家获颁 2026 年玛希隆王子奖
summary_cn: 泰国心脏科医生、比利时 Belgium 胎儿手术先驱和墨西哥 Mexico 营养研究员因在全球卫生领域的杰出贡献，获得 2026 年玛希隆王子奖 Prince Mahidol Award 的殊荣。玛希隆王子奖是泰国最高医学荣誉，每年表彰在医学和公共卫生领域做出杰出贡献的国际专业人士。
desc_original: A Thai cardiologist, a Belgian foetal surgery pioneer and a Mexican nutrition researcher have been named recipients of the 2026 Prince Mahidol Awards for their outstanding contributions to global health.

title: Myanmar backs checks
desc: Thailand and Myanmar will conduct joint inspections along the Kok and Sai rivers next month as part of efforts to curb cross-border pollution, the Pollution Control Department says.
title_cn: 缅甸同意联合检查跨境污染
summary_cn: 泰国与缅甸将于下月在库克河 Kok River 和赛河 Sai River 沿线进行联合巡查检验，作为遏制跨境污染的共同努力。泰国污染管制部门表示，此举旨在加强两国在环保领域的合作，防止工业污染跨界传播影响两国生态环境和人民健康。
desc_original: Thailand and Myanmar will conduct joint inspections along the Kok and Sai rivers next month as part of efforts to curb cross-border pollution, the Pollution Control Department says.

title: WHA puts focus on distribution centres
desc: SET-listed WHA Corporation, Thailand's largest developer of built-to-suit logistics facilities, is expanding its investments to build new distribution centres totalling more than 18 billion baht to support the continuous inflow of investments in Thailand, notably for data centres and cars.
title_cn: WHA 公司加码物流配送中心投资
summary_cn: 泰国股市上市公司 WHA 集团作为泰国最大的建造物流设施开发商，正在扩大投资规模，计划投建超过 180 亿泰铢的物流配送中心，以支撑外资持续涌入泰国，尤其是数据中心和汽车产业的产能需求。
desc_original: SET-listed WHA Corporation, Thailand's largest developer of built-to-suit logistics facilities, is expanding its investments to build new distribution centres totalling more than 18 billion baht to support the continuous inflow of investments in Thailand, notably for data centres and cars.

title: Call for AI benefits to be better shared across society
desc: A surge in artificial intelligence (AI) investment could widen the divide in the Thai economy, highlighting the need for stakeholders to ensure the benefits of technological advances are shared more broadly, according to Bank of Thailand governor Vitai Ratanakorn.
title_cn: 呼吁更公平分享人工智能发展红利
summary_cn: 泰国央行行长维泰·拉塔纳科恩 Vitai Ratanakorn 警示，人工智能 AI 投资激增可能加剧泰国经济分化，需要各方利益相关者确保技术进步的收益更广泛地为社会共享，防止贫富差距进一步扩大。这反映出泰国在推进数字化转型过程中面临的结构性挑战。
desc_original: A surge in artificial intelligence (AI) investment could widen the divide in the Thai economy, highlighting the need for stakeholders to ensure the benefits of technological advances are shared more broadly, according to Bank of Thailand governor Vitai Ratanakorn.

title: Govt defends 18% US tariff proposal
desc: The government has defended a proposed 18% US tariff on Thai goods, saying the rate puts Thailand on an equal footing with regional competitors and is lower than the 30% it could have faced without an early agreement with Washington.
title_cn: 泰国政府为18%美国关税方案辩护
summary_cn: 泰国政府为美国拟议的18%对泰商品关税进行辩护，表示这一税率使泰国与地区竞争对手处于平等地位，低于未与华盛顿达成早期协议可能面临的30%关税。
desc_original: The government has defended a proposed 18% US tariff on Thai goods, saying the rate puts Thailand on an equal footing with regional competitors and is lower than the 30% it could have faced without an early agreement with Washington.

title: Egat targets grid stability in new plan
desc: The Electricity Generating Authority of Thailand (Egat) has positioned itself as a key pillar in maintaining grid stability and ensuring power reliability under Thailand's new power development plan (PDP), as the country accelerates its transition towards renewable energy.
title_cn: 泰国电力生成局新规划中着力电网稳定
summary_cn: 泰国电力生成局（Egat）在国家新电力发展规划框架下，将自身定位为维持电网稳定和确保电力可靠性的关键支柱，以应对泰国向可再生能源加速转型的需求。
desc_original: The Electricity Generating Authority of Thailand (Egat) has positioned itself as a key pillar in maintaining grid stability and ensuring power reliability under Thailand's new power development plan (PDP), as the country accelerates its transition towards renewable energy.

title: Thailand leads as travel preferences evolve
desc: Thailand remains Agoda's top global destination for next year, attracting both international and domestic travellers, while second-tier destinations continue to gain popularity.
title_cn: 旅游偏好演变中泰国保持全球领先
summary_cn: 泰国继续位居Agoda明年全球顶级目的地，吸引大量国际和国内游客，而二线目的地的人气也在不断上升。
desc_original: Thailand remains Agoda's top global destination for next year, attracting both international and domestic travellers, while second-tier destinations continue to gain popularity.

title: สื่อนอกตีข่าว ระเบิด-ไฟไหม้โรงกลั่นน้ำมันในกรุงเทพฯ บาดเจ็บ 9 ราย
desc: สื่อต่างประเทศรายงานข่าวเหตุระเบิดที่โรงกลั่นน้ำมันของบริษัท บางจาก ในกรุงเทพฯ ซึ่งทำให้เกิดเหตุเพลิงไหม้ มีผู้ได้รับบาดเจ็บ 9 ราย อาการวิกฤต 3 รายเมื่อวันพฤหัสบดีที่ผ่านมา
title_cn: 外媒报道：曼谷炼油厂爆炸引发火灾致9人伤

title: Laem Chabang Port's new terminal opens
desc: Terminal D at Laem Chabang Port in Chon Buri has officially opened, adding annual cargo-handling capacity of 3.5 million twenty-foot equivalent units (TEUs) and boosting Thailand's ability to handle growing trade.
title_cn: 林查班港D码头正式启用
summary_cn: 位于尖竹汶府的林查班港D码头正式开放，新增年货物处理能力350万标准箱（TEU），进一步提升泰国应对贸易增长的能力。
desc_original: Terminal D at Laem Chabang Port in Chon Buri has officially opened, adding annual cargo-handling capacity of 3.5 million twenty-foot equivalent units (TEUs) and boosting Thailand's ability to handle growing trade.

title: Court orders seizure of Sathian's assets
desc: The National Anti-Corruption Commission (NACC) has announced a Supreme Court ruling ordering the seizure of 51 assets worth 296.3 million baht belonging to former defence permanent secretary Gen Sathian Phoemthong-in, nearly a year after the court delivered its final decision.
title_cn: 法院下令查封前国防常秘萨提安·佩姆通因的资产
summary_cn: 国家反腐委（NACC）宣布了最高法院的最新裁定：下令查封前国防常秘萨提安·佩姆通因中将（Sathian Phoemthong-in）拥有的51项资产，总价值约2.963亿泰铢。这项查封令是在法院近一年前做出最终判决后进入执行阶段，标志着针对这位高级军事官员的贪腐案件取得重要进展。
desc_original: The National Anti-Corruption Commission (NACC) has announced a Supreme Court ruling ordering the seizure of 51 assets worth 296.3 million baht belonging to former defence permanent secretary Gen Sathian Phoemthong-in, nearly a year after the court delivered its final decision.

title: Top court to rule on cadet case
desc: The Supreme Administrative Court is scheduled to deliver its ruling on Friday in a case about a disagreement over the Royal Thai Air Force's 2024 pilot cadet selection.
title_cn: 最高行政法院将裁决皇家空军学员选拔纠纷
summary_cn: 泰国最高行政法院将在本周五就皇家空军（Royal Thai Air Force）2024年度飞行员学员选拔程序中的重要争议案件做出最终裁决。该案涉及对空军选拔过程、标准和相关程序的异议和分歧，引起了公众和媒体的广泛关注。这项裁决预计将对空军人员招募制度产生重要影响。
desc_original: The Supreme Administrative Court is scheduled to deliver its ruling on Friday in a case about a disagreement over the Royal Thai Air Force's 2024 pilot cadet selection.

summary_cn: 泰国石油公司 Bangchak 位于曼谷 Phra Khanong 的炼油厂周四下午发生爆炸和火灾，已迅速控制。公司随后关闭该厂所有生产装置以确保安全。
desc_original: ​Bangchak ​Corp ⁠has ‌shut down all ⁠production units at its Phra ​Khanong oil ​refinery ‌in Bangkok following ⁠an explosion and fire that was quickly brought under control on Thursday afternoon.

title: Hua Hin Blues Festival returns for fourth edition on December 6
desc: Hua Hin Blues Festival returns for fourth edition on December 6 Legacy The fourth Hua Hin Blues Festival returns on Sunday, December 6, with 7.5 hours of live music over the Father’s Day long weekend and a move to the open-air grounds of The Kaset, Hua Hin, with Takiab Mountain as its backdrop. After three sold-out editions, blues lovers from across Thailand and the region are set to gather for a lineup of Thai and international acts. Doors open at 4pm, and live music runs until 11.30pm, with the festival billed as family-friendly and open to all ages. It brings together more than 800 music enthusiasts, urban weekenders, expats and families. Bigger grounds, same blues spirit The festival’s new home is an open-air paddock at the entrance of The Kaset Hotel in Nong Kae subdistrict, Hua Hin district, Prachuap Khiri Khan. Organisers say the space gives the event the scale of a major festival while keeping the intimate, soulful feel of the blues. title: Four Asian escapes for doing nothing, from a Samui cove to a Hakone onsen
desc: Four Asian escapes for doing nothing, from a Samui cove to a Hakone onsen Legacy Booking.com has drawn up a four-stop list of Asian escapes for the end of the year, and the common thread is rest. Hot springs, lagoon bungalows and spa treatments, rather than packed itineraries. The picks arrive with a piece of the company’s own research attached. Its Travel Happiness Index, an online survey of 10,136 people across 10 Asia Pacific markets carried out in May, found 46% of travellers in Thailand call travel an important part of their lives. Another 23% said they would only travel once they feel financially comfortable. That gap between wanting to go and being able to afford it is showing up in how people book. Nearly one in five Thai respondents, 16%, said they actively hunt for deals and cheaper destinations, and 72% said they would shift their dates or change where they go to get better value. One caveat is worth stating plainly. Every property below is sold on Booking.com and the list is the company’s own, so treat it as a shortlist to check rather than a ranking. title: BRN secretary-general Abdullah Munir dies in Malaysia, no successor named
desc: BRN secretary-general Abdullah Munir dies in Malaysia, no successor named Legacy The Malaysian daily Utusan Malaysia reported on Wednesday night that Abdullah Munir, the secretary-general of the Barisan Revolusi Nasional, had died the previous morning at a hospital in Kedah. He was 75. Utusan cited a senior figure in the group who asked not to be named. The source said Abdullah suffered a heart attack at his home in Tikam Batu, Kedah, and was taken to Sultan Abdul Halim Hospital in Sungai Petani, where he died. BRN is the largest of the armed separatist groups operating in Thailand’s three southernmost provinces. The source described Abdullah, also known as Ustaz Abdul Munir, as one of the longest serving figures in the organisation and said the secretary-general post placed him at the top of its hierarchy. That account has not been matched anywhere else. BRN has issued no statement in its own name, and no Thai or Malaysian government body has confirmed the death or said anything about it. The source said Abdullah took the post about four years ago, succeeding a figure named as Ustaz Mat Ladin. Thai security officials gave a different account in 2017. They told BenarNews then

title: Black Friday 2026 in Thailand: where to find the deals and how to shop smart
desc: Black Friday 2026 in Thailand: where to find the deals and how to shop smart Legacy Black Friday 2026 lands on Friday 27 November, and Thailand is already geared up for it. Central is running a four-day sale of up to 90% off across 43 branches nationwide, the big online platforms are lining up their own deals, and the banks are stacking cashback on top. Here is where the deals are, and how to shop them without falling for a fake discount. When is Black Friday 2026? Black Friday always falls on the Friday after the American Thanksgiving, which this year is Friday 27 November 2026. Cyber Monday, the online-focused follow-up, is Monday 30 November. In practice the sales do not wait for the day itself. Many shops and platforms open their offers a few days earlier and keep them running through the weekend, so the whole stretch from the last week of November is worth watching. In the malls: Central Black Friday 2026 Central’s official Black Friday 2026 key visual, with up to 90% off from 27 to 30 November. (Image: Central Pattana) Central is the headline act on the high street. Its Black Friday 2026 campaign runs from 27 to 30 November across Central department stores and Esplanade Ratch

title: Le Méridien Khao Lak Resort & Spa unveils La Fête 2026
desc: Le Méridien Khao Lak Resort & Spa unveils La Fête 2026 Legacy Christmas Eve buffets, a shared turkey feast and a beachfront New Year’s Eve gala with fireworks headline the Khao Lak festive season at Le Méridien Khao Lak Resort & Spa. The resort has unveiled La Fête 2026, a curated collection of festive experiences designed around joy, connection and memorable moments by the sea. The programme runs from Christmas traditions and festive dining through to a New Year’s Eve celebration beneath the stars, with La Fête turning the shores of Khao Lak into the ultimate festive destination. Tree lighting, carols and children’s activities The season begins with a Tree Lighting Ceremony and Christmas carols, creating a warm, festive atmosphere. Families can join dedicated children’s activities, including holiday crafts, cookie decorating, festive games and creative experiences for younger guests. A season of Christmas magic The festivities begin on December 24 with the Christmas Eve Grand Festive Buffet at Beach Grill. title: Fire breaks out at Bangchak oil refinery in Bangkok
desc: Fire breaks out at Bangchak oil refinery in Bangkok Legacy A fire broke out at Bangchak’s oil refinery in Bangkok this afternoon, November 26, sending thick black smoke into the sky and prompting evacuation warnings for nearby residents. The company later reported that the situation was under control, although people were still advised to leave the surrounding area as a precaution. At 2.48pm, the Bang Na District Office issued an emergency warning on Facebook, reporting an explosion at the Bangchak facility near Sukhumvit Soi 62 in Phra Khanong district and urging nearby residents to evacuate. Photo via Facebook: Fire & Rescue Thailand V-2 Thick black smoke was visible from a distance, causing concern among residents and motorists nearby. Firefighters from Phra Khanong Fire and Rescue Station were dispatched with fire engines and rescue teams to contain the blaze and prevent it from spreading to other parts of the refinery or nearby communities. Motorists were also advised to avoid Sukhumvit Soi 62 and the Old Railway Road, which emergency vehicles and fire engines were using to reach the facility. Photo via Facebook: Fire & Rescue Thailand V-2 At 3.10pm, Deputy Inter
